news.title: Death Toll from Capsized Ship in Indonesia Rises to 20 as Search Continues for 115 Missing Passengers
news.summary: The official death toll from a passenger ship that capsized and sank in Indonesia's Java Sea rose to 20 on Wednesday, up from the previous 10, with rescuers expecting to find more bodies as the ongoing underwater search widens, officials said.

news.title: Russia’s Arctic Port Murmansk to Use Fertilizer Equipment to Start Shipping Grain
news.summary: Russia's Arctic port of Murmansk will use equipment typically used to load fertilizer when it ships its first grain from southern Russia for export as early as next month, as the Black Sea route remains closed due to Ukrainian drone attacks.
